# Resize-It

> Free image and PDF tools that run entirely in the browser. Files are processed on the user's device and are never uploaded to a server. No sign-up, no watermark.

Resize-It (https://www.resize-it.com) resizes, compresses, crops, converts and edits images, makes passport and visa photos, and compresses or merges PDFs. Because processing is local (HTML canvas, pdf-lib), it suits sensitive documents such as ID photos and forms.

## Image tools

- [Image Resizer](https://www.resize-it.com/resize): Resize to exact pixels, percent, mm, cm or inches. Keeps PNG/WebP transparency. Batch resize downloads as a ZIP.
- [Image Compressor](https://www.resize-it.com/compress): Compress by quality, or to a maximum file size in KB (for example 20 KB, 50 KB or 100 KB for online forms). Never returns a file larger than the original.
- [Image Cropper](https://www.resize-it.com/crop): Free crop or fixed ratios (1:1, 16:9, 4:3, 3:2, 9:16). Works with touch.
- [Round Corners](https://www.resize-it.com/round-corners): Rounded or circular corners, PNG output with transparency.
- [Invert Image](https://www.resize-it.com/invert), [Lighten Image](https://www.resize-it.com/lighten), [Saturate Image](https://www.resize-it.com/saturate): Colour adjustments.

## Exact-size presets

- [3000×3000 image](https://www.resize-it.com/resize/3000x3000) (album covers, print-on-demand)
- [Square image (pad to 1:1)](https://www.resize-it.com/resize/square)
- [Instagram post 1080×1080](https://www.resize-it.com/resize/instagram-post), [YouTube thumbnail 1280×720](https://www.resize-it.com/resize/youtube-thumbnail), [Facebook cover 1200×630](https://www.resize-it.com/resize/facebook-cover), [Pinterest pin 1000×1500](https://www.resize-it.com/resize/pinterest-pin)
- Crop to platform size: [Instagram](https://www.resize-it.com/crop/instagram-post), [YouTube](https://www.resize-it.com/crop/youtube-thumbnail), [Facebook](https://www.resize-it.com/crop/facebook-cover), [Pinterest](https://www.resize-it.com/crop/pinterest-pin)

## Format converters

- [JPEG to PNG](https://www.resize-it.com/jpeg-to-png), [JPEG to WebP](https://www.resize-it.com/jpeg-to-webp), [PNG to WebP](https://www.resize-it.com/png-to-webp), [WebP to JPEG](https://www.resize-it.com/webp-to-jpeg), [WebP to PNG](https://www.resize-it.com/webp-to-png)

## Passport and visa photos

The [passport photo tool](https://www.resize-it.com/passport) crops to official sizes for 60+ countries, prints a sheet of copies (PDF at 600 DPI) and, where a country publishes an online upload spec, exports a matching digital JPG. These country pages list requirements checked against official government sources, with links to those sources:

- [United States (2×2 in)](https://www.resize-it.com/passport/united-states)
- [United Kingdom (35×45 mm)](https://www.resize-it.com/passport/united-kingdom)
- [Canada (50×70 mm)](https://www.resize-it.com/passport/canada)
- [Australia (35–40 × 45–50 mm)](https://www.resize-it.com/passport/australia)
- [New Zealand (digital, 3:4)](https://www.resize-it.com/passport/new-zealand)
- [India (35×45 mm)](https://www.resize-it.com/passport/india)
- [Pakistan (35×45 mm)](https://www.resize-it.com/passport/pakistan)
- [Nigeria (600×800 px upload)](https://www.resize-it.com/passport/nigeria)
- [Sri Lanka (digital, authorised studios only)](https://www.resize-it.com/passport/sri-lanka)
- [Iran (30×40 mm)](https://www.resize-it.com/passport/iran)
- [Hong Kong (40×50 mm)](https://www.resize-it.com/passport/hong-kong)
- [Taiwan (35×45 mm)](https://www.resize-it.com/passport/taiwan)
- [Morocco (35×45 mm)](https://www.resize-it.com/passport/morocco)
- [Mexico](https://www.resize-it.com/passport/mexico), [Peru](https://www.resize-it.com/passport/peru), [Colombia](https://www.resize-it.com/passport/colombia): the passport photo is taken at the office.
